# Support

CmdImpact is maintained on a best-effort basis while it is in alpha.

- Use [GitHub Discussions](https://github.com/khajaaijaz26/cmdimpact/discussions) for setup and usage questions.
- Use the issue forms for reproducible bugs and focused feature requests.
- Use [private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/khajaaijaz26/cmdimpact/security/advisories/new) for security concerns.

Always include the CmdImpact version and deployment method. Remove tokens, private hosts, usernames, paths, personal data, commands, and terminal output before posting publicly.
